_readme: Active additional aquatic-species models for BlueEye. Only entries listed here are loaded into the registry, the Models page and the model selectors. An entry whose weights exist on disk is usable; an entry is never shown as READY until it actually loads and runs. Entries that cannot run today (no weights, or an unsupported format) live in models/custom/inactive_models.json instead. BlueEye never fabricates weights. Schema and worked examples: models/custom/README.md.

models.name: Aquatic Fauna (brackish / estuarine)
models.summary: Six-class underwater detector fine-tuned on brackish / estuarine footage.
models.description: crab, fish, jellyfish, shrimp, small_fish, starfish
models.limitations: Trained on one Danish brackish camera; an analogue for estuaries/backwaters, not Indian rivers.
models.status_note: Verified locally (loads + detects). Trained on one Danish brackish camera; not India-specific but relevant to estuaries/backwaters.

models.name: Underwater Fish (grayscale)
models.license: US Government work - not subject to copyright, royalty-free use
models.summary: Single-class fish detector for black-and-white underwater camera footage.
models.limitations: Trained on grayscale imagery; may under-detect on colour footage. Generic 'fish' class only.
models.status_note: Verified locally (loads + runs). Trained on grayscale imagery; may under-detect on colour footage.

models.name: Aquarium & Reef Species
models.summary: Seven-class detector for aquarium / reef footage; includes shark and stingray.
models.description: fish, jellyfish, penguin, puffin, shark, starfish, stingray
models.limitations: Community-contributed: weights load and detect, but no published evaluation metrics.
models.status_note: Community-contributed: weights load and detect, but no published evaluation metrics.

models.name: OBSEA Mediterranean Species (21)
models.summary: Species-level detector for 21 Mediterranean coastal species, including groupers, seabreams and rays.
models.description: 21 classes: Mediterranean reef fish, wrasse, moray, groupers, seabreams, Myliobatidae (rays)
models.limitations: Mediterranean species only - not Indian species. Trained at imgsz 1920; small fish may need a larger inference size.
models.status_note: Verified locally (21 classes load; detects on a real reef image). Species names are Mediterranean, not Indian.

models.name: Community Fish Detector
models.summary: Strong general fish detector trained on the ~1.9M-image Community Fish Detection dataset.
models.limitations: Single generic 'fish' class - does not identify a species. Trained at imgsz 1024.
models.status_note: Verified locally (loads + detects). Single generic 'fish' class only.

models.name: Fishial Detector (YOLO26-n)
models.summary: MIT-licensed general fish detector; emits a single generic 'Fish' class.
models.limitations: Single generic 'Fish' class - identifies no species. Distributed as a zip; BlueEye verifies the extracted 'model.pt' by SHA-256.
models.status_note: Verified locally (loads + detects). Single generic 'Fish' class only.
